current.name: P2PEscrow
current.note: Deployed from the generated compact build, because Bradbury rejects larger deploys (see deploy_ceiling). The public API and every stored field name are identical to the readable source; the build only strips docstrings and shortens internal identifiers. Regenerate with `py -3.12 scripts/make_compact_build.py` — it is byte-reproducible.

deploy_ceiling.rule_of_thumb: Keep generated calldata below ~20,000 bytes. scripts/make_compact_build.py prints a warning when a build exceeds it.
evidence: 20132 B (pre-P0 build) deployed successfully at block 21714458
21892 B and 32452 B both failed with status 0x0 during the same period
the identical 21223 B source deployed successfully on Studionet, so the code itself is not the problem

how_to_verify: eth_getTransactionByHash(<transaction_hash>) returns the deploy transaction; its logs carry the address above.
eth_getCode(<address>) returns a ~300-byte ghost contract, the same footprint as every Intelligent Contract on this network.
sha256sum contracts/p2p_escrow_deploy.py must equal artifact_sha256; that exact file is what was sent as deploy calldata.
